name: AttestOS
line: Bot checks your visitors never see.
what: An invisible proof-of-work check with a server-side verify call, in place of CAPTCHA puzzles.

name: TightBucket
what: Twenty-second audits that show where a website loses revenue, with the evidence and the fix, for stores, SaaS, sales teams and agencies.

name: DeskOS
line: Working desks for customs, safari and tender firms.
what: Web desks with working calculators for customs and freight, safari and DMC, and tender and donor ESG firms, with daily open notices for tender firms from 13 public sources (World Bank, UN agencies, EU TED and national portals), by region.

name: STPi
what: Hunts public job ads across African markets, drafts a cover letter and tailored CV for each, and waits for a person to approve before anything is sent.
for: Job seekers, coaches and placement firms

name: Tapstall
line: A shop link for the markets the big platforms skip.
what: A storefront link for informal and social-commerce shops that understands EcoCash, InnBucks and PayShap and matches exact payment amounts.
for: Small shops in Zimbabwe and South Africa
buy_label: Open a shop — free for 60 days

name: Open Practice
what: A learning platform where people practise with AI tools on real tasks, using their own free API keys, and keep what they make.
for: Anyone learning to work with AI

name: Mechanism Audit
line: The product audit that reads the evidence.
what: A five-day written audit of what a product actually does: the claim on the page, the mechanism behind it, and the gap in writing. Three priced products — the audit, a self-check pack and a fix sprint — sold through the store.
for: Founders and product teams who need a working product distinguished from a convincing demo.
